# Trackora

> Trackora is a local-first, privacy-focused desktop screen time and productivity tracker for Windows and Linux (GNOME Wayland).

## Overview
- **Privacy & Local-First**: Zero tracking telemetry, zero cloud accounts, and 100% offline local SQLite storage. All activity logs remain on the user's local machine.
- **Supported Platforms**: Windows 10/11 (64-bit standalone installer & portable zip) and Linux (Fedora RPM & tarball for GNOME Wayland).
- **Core Features**:
  - Live active application tracking with low overhead (< 0.1% CPU).
  - Activity Timeline, Daily/Weekly analytics charts, application category classification, and custom goals.
  - AFK & Idle Observer to exclude idle periods.
  - Non-blocking asynchronous icon extraction for responsive UI.
  - Pause Tracking functionality from settings or system tray.
  - Safe data backups and database management tools.

## Key Links & Resources
- Official Website: https://trackora-tracker.vercel.app
- Source Code Repository: https://github.com/SamXop123/Trackora
- Full AI Documentation: https://trackora-tracker.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Quick Install
- Windows Installer: Download `TrackoraSetup.exe` from https://trackora-tracker.vercel.app
- Linux Fedora: `sudo dnf install ./trackora-2.2.0.rpm`
